line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.14: Instead of returning only growth, now returns an array as follows:
* 1. The growth rate
* 2. The maximum growth rate
* 3. The growth rate multiplier (a percentage ranging from 0 to 100).
* Safety: if pop restriction is 0, return with all 0.
* Add-Ons 1.14: Now uses effective population rather than current population (was previously used only in pop assembly).
* This patches a pop manipulation exploit by calculating the effective population count (current population + crew cost while building ships) before checking below.
* Add-Ons 1.12.1: Patch exploit where player could manipulate pop growth to get a lot of pops. Check the max pop ever reached.
* Initialize in case it's null (for existing games). Otherwise it's 0, initially set by Mayhem.InitializeOutpost; or it'll have a value set by Mayhem.Task.Station.Outpost.
* Maximum natural growth
* Default 9, minimum of 1. Add-Ons 2.2: always 9.
* Terraforming bonuses.
* Herobetty 5.3: AI factions, if they control a terraformed sector obtained from the player, can benefit from this perk as well.
* Add-Ons 1.8: Moved terraforming up here. Now affected by growth penalty if the perk is not enabled.
* Max-pop scaling bonus.
* Add-Ons 1.8: Reworked population growth rate scaling from Add-Ons 1.2 (was +1 pop growth per 100 pops).
* If the maximum population is more than 100, then bonus growth scales by 1% for every 2 additional pops.
* Add-Ons 1.8: -80% growth rate rather than reducing growth rate to 1 pop per cycle.
* Add-Ons 1.14: Tax perk now reduces maximum natural growth by 50%.
* ZH 2.0 - Tax perk is even worse, but only above half pop limit
* Initialize growth rate percentage.
* Add-Ons 1.9.5: If this Outpost has the Industrial overdrive perk, then natural growth is disabled. Same applies to OCV playthroughs.
* Growth limiter
* Normal empire. Growth rate limitation is dynamic.
* Add-Ons 1.12.1: Check the max pop reached for the initial growth rate. Also changed threshold (30 -> 40) and bootstrap growth (20 -> 40). (1.14 tied constant 40 to a variable.)
* ZH 2.0 - flat initial growth rate to always get beyond first 40 people very quickly
* Add-Ons 1.8: If the natural pop growth limit is less than 20, set amount to 20. (1.12.1: changed to 40; 1 boosted cycle brings them to 40)
* Add-Ons 1.14: No longer uses thresholds. 50.00% at 0% pop cap -> 25.00% at full effective pop.
* $mult100 ranges from 5000 to 2500.
* Final growth = Base growth * (0.5 - 0.25 * popRatio); Pop ratio = effective pop / maxPop
* $naturalGrowth = ($maxNaturalGrowth * (50 - (25 * $people) / $peopleRestriction)) / 100
* Rounded integer percentage for GUI.
* Divide by 10000 because $mult100 is percent * 100 (ensures percentage with 2 fractional points).
* Update the remainder only when the Outpost intends to grow pops.
* Clamping
* No minimum 1 clamp anymore. Remainder handles fractional growth.
* Restriction clamp.
* Absolute sector cap clamp.
* Zero Hour handles max population here by limiting growth and not by limiting max pop in Mayhem.Task.Station.Outpost because of Refugees
* Final safety clamp. Never negative.
